title: The 2027 Town Centre Renewal Fund: which designated town centres qualify
setting: A fictional self-governing island nation, Torvasay, whose statistics office compiles each designated town centre's workplace retail employment from the tax authority's PAYE returns, the valuation office's rating lists and the district councils' business rates accounts: the island, its bodies, the firms and the people are fictional, and every record is synthetic.
